standard: Visible construction improvement acceptable at application scale; not a numerical quality score or production release approval.

front.note: Rounded upper and lower bouts now clearly replace the original angular dreadnought outline.

rear.note: The curved back and two smooth binding rails retain stand, neck and cradle alignment.

underside.note: Body underside and tripod contacts remain coherent with no missing plate or new opening.

clay.note: Material-free silhouette confirms actual smooth body construction rather than a shading-only change.

front.note: Five scalloped crown lobes are now connected above the upholstered stem without black triangular holes.

rear.note: Crown remains continuous from behind, with its shallow stepped upholstery panels and original overall height.

detail.note: Both pillow welt loops sit on their covers; three original white buttons are seated into the headboard instead of hovering.

underside.note: Closed bed base and supported mattress remain unchanged in their placement; no new underside defect is visible.

clay.note: Closed crown, tuft contact and soft pillows remain readable without color; simple block base and coverlet are acceptable limitations.
